demo.code:
# 1. Free: inspect BunnBase's live on-chain B20 stock holdings & Chainlink 24/5 status
node scripts/bunnbase.mjs console

# 2. Free: check Morpho VaultV2 live USDC APY on Base Mainnet
node scripts/bunnbase.mjs vault

# 3. Paid ($0.02 USDC x402): calculate a B20 compute-hedge basket for $50/mo Anthropic spend
node scripts/bunnbase.mjs hedge anthropic 50

# 4. Paid ($0.02 USDC x402): scan NVDAc, GOOGLc, ANTc, MSFTc, AAPLc, METAc spreads on Base
node scripts/bunnbase.mjs scanner NVDA,GOOGL,ANT,MSFT,AAPL,META 10

setup: Install the bunnbase-compute-hedge skill in your agent
Run free telemetry checks (`console`, `vault`, `balance`) with zero setup
For paid x402 endpoints (`hedge`, `scanner`, `preflight`, `lend-route`, `verify`), settle the Base USDC challenge via your x402 client or Bankr wallet
